# The Selkie Bay Hotel

> An eighteen-room, four-star boutique hotel on the harbour at North Berwick,
> East Lothian, Scotland. A quiet coastal escape — tide, weather, and a working
> harbour view, not a resort feel. Best rates are always on the hotel's own site.

## Key pages

- [Rooms & Suites](/rooms): The eighteen rooms — Classic, Deluxe and Suites, each facing the harbour, garden or bay.
- [Dining](/dining): The dining room — harbour cooking by head chef Euan Tait, led by the tide and the walled garden.
- [Experiences](/experiences): House-arranged days out — gin, water, rock and shore — starting at the front door.
- [Weddings](/weddings): Exclusive-use weddings on the East Lothian coast, one at a time.
- [Special Offers](/offers): Current direct-booking offers — seasonal stays and midweek escapes.
- [Location & Directions](/location): Finding the hotel by road, rail and air; what to see nearby.
- [Journal](/journal): Notes from the house — the garden, the bay, the kitchen and the people who keep it.
- [Our Story](/about): History, team and ethos of the house.
- [Contact](/contact): Phone, email and enquiry form; questions answered by a person within one working day.

## Booking

Book direct through the site for the best available rate, no booking fees, and a
complimentary welcome dram. Check availability from any page.
